result.title: SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. Furthermore, we develop Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation (CGVA), which captures local feature deviations relative to multi-scale neighborhood contexts and refines patch representations through adaptive gating. By integrating distribution-aware semantic modeling with context-sensitive visual adaptation, SCRA-CLIP facilitates more discriminative cross-modal matching for fine-grained anomaly detection and localization. Extensive experiments on 11 industrial and medical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of SCRA-CLIP across diverse unseen categories and domains. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SCRA-CLIP 用于零样本异常检测：以 von Mises–Fisher 混合建模正常/异常 patch 特征的方向分布并生成原型条件化文本提示，同时用多尺度邻域上下文偏差和自适应门控精炼 patch 表示，从而改善细粒度异常检测与定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「相对多尺度邻域上下文的偏差 + 门控」选择并改写 patch 表示的机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与细粒度细节保留提供可核查的线索；但该工作属下游检测适配，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。
